title: Form
summary: A form drawn from field descriptions: the label row, «*», «?», hint and error around each control the Framework's field renderers draw, groups, one column that pairs fields from 44rem, an errors summary with links from two errors, the buttons under the fields with the main one first, a view mode with «Изменить», and apply submit, instant or answer (a questionnaire answered once, read-only with «Отправлено» after it) in one component.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

apply.description: submit: the form is saved with its button -- «Сохранить» and «Отмена» under the fields, a required yes/no is a checkbox (C165 (4)), «Есть несохранённые изменения» under the buttons after a change. instant: every change acts at once -- no buttons, a change event per field, a required yes/no is a switch (a settings panel, a block's parameters). answer: a form a person answers once, a questionnaire in a message or a feed entry (owner decision C291 (3)) -- «Отправить» and «Отмена» under the fields; a press puts the answer on its way (state pending, «Отправляем…»), the host sets the outcome; accepted shows the values read-only with the mark «Отправлено» and no «Изменить», nothing reopens them; mode is not read

size.description: The rung of the fields and the buttons on the size ladder: 1, or 1/2 for a form in a message (owner decision C291 (3)). The label, the hint and the error keep the 1/2 text step at both

state.description: apply answer only: where the answer is, the confirm surface's words (sf-confirm). open: the fields and «Отправить», «Отмена». pending: an answer is on its way, set by a press -- the fields are locked, the pressed button waits, «Отправляем…» (or «Отменяем…»). accepted: the values sent, read-only, with «Отправлено». declined: nothing is drawn (C35: a declined answer says nothing). expired: only «Время ответа истекло». The host sets the outcome; back to open when the answer could not be delivered (with set-errors for the fields to fix)

labels.description: top: the label above its field (the default). start: the label stands beside its field, the labels of a group in one column as wide as the longest label up to 40 % of the row and every field after it on one axis -- the row of a settings page and of an admin card, and a record's group edited in place (C401); it switches as sf-list-description's layout auto does (C180 (3)): beside from a form wider than 20rem, above in a narrower one and on a phone (below md). The value name top is a working name (name to confirm)

footer.description: static: the buttons under the last field, the main one first at the start. sticky: the same buttons in a bar that sticks to the bottom of the scrolling place while the form is longer than it -- a settings page (C166 (3)). The value name static is a working name (name to confirm)

label.description: The form's accessible name (the native form's aria-label), so a screen reader announces it as a form landmark; best the heading the form stands under. Working name (name to confirm)

guard.description: The leave guard (FS-4, C166 (6), C422): while the form holds unsaved changes, closing or reloading the tab asks the browser's question, and a press on a link that leaves the page -- another page, or a route the page draws in place (an address in the page that names no element) -- is held: the cancelable leave event goes out, and the form asks «Уйти без сохранения?» in a question window with C159 (6)'s answers, «Не сохранять» (red, first; the fields go back and the link is pressed again) and «Продолжить правку» (quiet, with the focus; the page and the menu stay). A link inside the form, one that opens another tab or downloads, or a press with a modifier key passes. Working name (name to confirm)

readonly.description: A form the person may read but not change (FS-5, C348, C422): the values as text, as mode view draws them, with no «Изменить» and no «Сохранить»; the reason line (readonly-reason) stands where the buttons would. Not read under apply answer

readonly-reason.description: readonly: why the form cannot be changed, said where the buttons would stand («Менять настройки сайта может администратор сайта»); «Только чтение» by default. Working name (name to confirm)

mode.description: edit: the fields. view: the values as text (the field renderers' view, as a record card shows them) with «Изменить» under them; «Изменить» opens edit, and «Сохранить» or «Отмена» return to view. Working name (name to confirm)

busy.description: While the host saves (FS-2, C159 (9)): «Сохранить» shows its loading in its own colour, «Отмена» waits, every field is read-only and a second press or Enter does nothing; the form is aria-busy. The host that cancels submit to save sets it and answers with the saved action, set-errors, a new value or busy false, each of which ends it

saved-at.description: When the values were last saved, an ISO date and time (FS-3): the state line under the buttons says «Сохранено в 14:35» in the reader's clock until the next change, which empties it and says «Есть несохранённые изменения». Written by a submit not cancelled and by the saved action; a host may set it from code. Working name (name to confirm)

fields.description: The fields, in order: the Framework field descriptor that sf-view-properties sends -- the property registry's type, its template and its parameters (propertyType, template and templateParams -- variant is the former name of template until 2027-01-01 --, required, readonly, placeholder, options, min, max, step, unit, decimals, currency, currencies, currencyDisplay, holder (a ru.inn field: any, organization -- 10 digits -- or person -- 12), defaultCountry (a phone field: the ISO 3166 alpha-2 country an empty field starts on, else the page's) … as SF.fieldRenderers.registry lists them) plus key, label, hint, help, width and group. width short (the field width step of 20 characters, 160 px at text 16), medium (28, 224 px) or full -- s and m, the former names, read as short and medium until 2027-01-01; without it a field pairs with its neighbour from 44rem of the form's own width. A field of a type the field renderers do not draw is left out

groups.description: The groups the fields' group keys name, in order: {key, label}. With two or more, each is a fieldset with its label as the legend, 24 apart over a line. A field without a group, or with a group not listed, stands in one group of its own after the listed ones

field-host.description: The record host's half of the field renderers' host interface (1.7.0), a property only: getFieldOptionsPage, getFieldOptionSearch, setFieldOptionSearch and loadFieldOptions page and search a record, relation or user picker (template reference_picker); getFieldUploads, startFieldUpload and retryFieldUpload transfer a file (template upload: the upload area is drawn and says its own error); getFieldText and formatFieldValue are the host's words and formatting; renderField(field, value, host, {editing, size}) draws a type a component set draws (items, complex, ru.requisites). Each is called with the renderers' arguments and, last, the form's host for that field, whose setFieldValue writes into the form's value (a stored file the host was handed). The form keeps setFieldValue and setFieldError, so the values, their checks and the submit stay the form's. Without it a picker pages the field's own options and a file field keeps the chosen files in its value ({name, size, mime, file}: the File for the host to send with the values). Working name (name to confirm)

origin.description: Where the fields' values come from, the words every field with an origin says (FS-1, owner decision C422): own (the lead of an own value, «Своё для simai.ru»; «Своё значение» by default), above (the upper level before its value, «у всех сайтов»; «общее»), inherited (the quiet line of an inherited value, «Как у всех сайтов»; none by default, C422 marks only an own value and a locked one) and locked (the reason a field is closed above; «Закрыто на уровне выше»). A field's own origin words win. Working name (name to confirm)

value.description: The values by field key: {text: "Подробнее", tone: "accent"}. Set from code it is the saved state: the form shows it, forgets the errors and is not dirty; read, it is what the fields hold now and what a save sends: a field its conditions hide (when.visible) is left out, while the form keeps what it held so that showing the field again brings it back (FO3-1, Larena settings standard §4). A value the person never set is absent

checkValidity.summary: Checks every field it shows and shows every error, as «Сохранить» does but without submit: applied when right, refused {reason: invalid} otherwise (§17.4). Moves no focus

reset.summary: Every field returns to the saved state, without events; the errors and the summary are gone (§17.4)

refreshFields.summary: The field host's answers changed -- a page of candidates, an upload's progress, a stored file -- and the fields are drawn again with what it answers now (1.7.0). The form draws again by itself when a host call answers a promise that settles. Working name (name to confirm)

setErrors.summary: The host's answer to a submit: {key: message} -- each named field shows the message as its error until the person changes it, from two a summary takes the focus as after «Сохранить»; an empty object clears them. A form in view opens edit. refused {reason: missing} when no key names a field it shows. Working name (name to confirm)

saved.summary: The host's answer to a save it took over (it cancelled submit, FS-2, FS-3): the values the fields hold are the saved state -- dirty false, busy false, saved-at the given ISO time or now, «Сохранено в HH:MM» in the state line; a form opened from view returns to view. refused {reason: mode} in view, under apply instant or answer

confirmLeave.summary: A host's own route asks before it leaves (FS-4): applied at once when the form has no unsaved changes, else after «Уйти без сохранения?» -- applied with «Не сохранять» (the fields are back to the saved state), refused {reason: stayed} with «Продолжить правку». Working name (name to confirm)

sf-form-input.summary: A field's value changed by the person: its key and the new value (undefined when the field withdrew an incomplete text). Sent as sf-form-input, not input: the fields' own native input events bubble through the form unchanged

sf-form-change.summary: apply instant only: a field's value is applied (§8, one per commit of the field): typed text when the control commits it (its change: leaving the field, Enter) or the person leaves the field, a choice, a box or a file at once; only a value that differs from the one last applied. Sent as sf-form-change, not change: the fields' own native change events bubble through the form unchanged

sf-form-submit.summary: apply submit: «Сохранить» (or Enter in a one-line field) found every field right; value is every shown field's value by key (a field its conditions hide is not sent, FO3-1). Not cancelled, the value becomes the saved state (dirty false) and a form that was opened from view returns to view; cancelled, the form stays as it is (the host answers later, with set-errors or a new value). Not cancelled, the state line says «Сохранено в HH:MM» (saved-at); a host that cancels it to save sets busy and answers with the saved action (FS-2, FS-3)

inherited.description: FS-1: the keys whose value is the upper level's again (a field with origin.value equal to it), for a host that stores them as inherited rather than as an own value

sf-form-answer.summary: apply answer: «Отправить» found every field right (accepted true, with the value) or «Отмена» was pressed (accepted false). Sent with state pending; the host sets the outcome, in its handler or later: accepted, declined, or open again. Cancelled, the answer was not taken: the form is open again and may be answered again (the confirm surface's answer)

value.description: With accepted true: every field's value by key, as submit carries it

sf-form-invalid.summary: A submit or check-validity found wrong fields: their keys in order. Every one shows its error at the field; from two errors a summary with a link to each stands over the form and takes the focus. A host error (set-errors) for a field its conditions hide is said in the summary by the field's label, without a link, and does not hold the next submit back (FO3-1)

sf-form-cancel.summary: «Отмена»: the fields went back to the saved state (value), the errors are gone; a form opened from view returns to view

sf-form-reset-field.summary: «Вернуть общее» under a field with an own value (FS-1): the field's key and the upper level's value it takes. Not cancelled, the field takes it as the person's change -- dirty until «Сохранить», applied at once (change) in an instant form -- and the focus goes to the field; cancelled, nothing changes. Working name (name to confirm)

sf-form-leave.summary: guard: a press on a link that leaves the page while the form holds unsaved changes (FS-4); href is where it goes. The press is held before anything else hears it. Not cancelled, the form asks «Уйти без сохранения?» and, after «Не сохранять», presses the link again; cancelled, the host takes it over (its own question, or the reset action and its own route). Working name (name to confirm)

forbidden_client_responsibilities: saving the values (the host hears submit or change and saves them)
checking a value against the server's rules (the host answers with set-errors)
deciding who may change a field (the host sends readonly)

keyboard: Tab walks the fields in order, then «Сохранить» and «Отмена» (or «Изменить» in view)
Enter in a one-line field submits the form
After a submit with two errors or more the focus is on the summary; Tab reaches its links, and Enter on a link moves the focus to that field
accessibility.focus: A submit with one error moves the focus to that field, with two or more to the summary. «Изменить» moves it to the first field; returning to view moves it to «Изменить».

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-form for a form drawn from a list of field descriptions: a record's edit, a settings page, a block's parameters (apply instant), a sign-up or a request on a site.
do_not: Do not draw the label, the «*», the hint or the error beside a field by hand; give them in the descriptor
Do not disable «Сохранить» until the form is right; the form says what is wrong
Do not show read-only values as disabled fields; use mode view
Do not put two columns by hand; the form pairs fields from 44rem of its own width
